author: qu0b
content: A lot of the repricing is missing and state gas is not considered

author: qu0b
content: Calculating the execution gas for leanSPHINCS is for example, not really helpful, since state gas will always be more through the call data floor than execution gas can ever cost

I think next steps are to:

- Make a branch in execution-specs ontop of bogota-3 since that will have leanSPHINCS with no aggregation. Lets call this 8288-devnet-0 or agg-devnet-0 or pq-el-devnet-0 . There will be many devnets that are short lived like we usually have.

- First devnet would only have builder aggregation like the proposal noted

author: kevaundray
content: On daisugi, I'd suggest we sunset it instead of rebasing it ontop of bogota-2

author: gurukamath
content: We are still in the process of looking at what shape frames take for `bogota-devnet-3` but it does makes sense for this to be built on top of that

author: marchhill
content: I'm not too sure about moving to builder aggregation only, since mempool aggregation is one of the main things it's important to test and work on

author: kevaundray
content: Yep I agree that mempool aggregation is important, we could do that on agg-devnet-1 for example

author: kevaundray
content: There is a possibility that we ship with just builder aggregation since mempool aggregation is a harder problem, so I think having specs and numbers for it is also important, also to know what the diff is between builder aggregation and mempool aggregation in terms of resource requirements

author: marchhill
content: My reservation about shipping builder-only aggregation first is what happens to self-building in the meantime. Especially if leansphincs + aggregation path becomes the default most popular path, a self-builder wouldn't be able to keep up and prove many of those pq transactions. That's an even bigger problem if we don't have FOCIL by then

author: kevaundray
content: This makes sense, though I'd want to separate information gathering from decision making, especially given that builder aggregation as written is a stepping stone to mempool aggregation
